name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – After § 25 – Am 29
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 25a. Considers that the widespread freezing of the funds and economic resources belonging to Russia’s political and economic elites who support and benefit from the Russian authoritarian regime is key to eroding support for the Russian invasion of Ukraine and ramping up pressure on the Kremlin; calls on the Commission to make a proposal to considerably extend the list of persons and entities affected by the EU sanctions on assets, which currently consists of 1 879 persons and 507 entities; indicates that if these sanctions were to be applied to the persons owning more than EUR 10 million in assets, about 20 000 persons would fall within their scope;
